subject: planner: always keep join keys by default (#63470)
summary: The only code change flips `vardef.DefOptAlwaysKeepJoinKey` from `false` to `true` (`pkg/sessionctx/vardef/tidb_vars.go`), making `tidb_opt_always_keep_join_key` default ON. This affects planner behavior via existing uses of `SessionVars.AlwaysKeepJoinKey` in join constant-propagation paths, preserving `t1.col = t2.col` join keys even when logically redundant, which changes plan choices (e.g., more MergeJoin/IndexJoin) but does not change SQL semantics/correctness by itself. No later follow-up changes to this sysvar/default were found up to `upstream/master` via `git log -S` search.
